crucialFeats: Survives the Source Wall and returns with the Life Equation.
Erases the Source Titans from existence using the Life Equation.
His power nearly destabilizes reality itself.
Unwillingly creates life by his presence.
Changes The Source — the code on which reality is built.

dossier.advantage: Immense versatility and regeneration. White light allows him to heal wounds, recreate matter, and adapt his responses to vastly different threats.
dossier.mentality: Creative, determined, and flexible under pressure. Kyle does not fight by a rigid script — he improvises, adapts quickly, and can escalate his power when the situation demands more than a normal exchange.
dossier.quote: In brightest day, there will be light, To cleanse the soul and set wrongs right. When darkness falls, look to the skies, A new dawn comes, let there be light!
dossier.style: Creative combat with white light constructs. He uses the full spectrum to create an exceptionally wide range of offensive and defensive solutions.

fighterA.name: White Lantern Kyle Rayner

powers: White Lantern spectrum access, construct creation, healing, life-force manipulation, and teleportation.
tools: Life Equation and the ring's versatility in offense, defense, healing, and restoration.
weaknesses: Ring dependence and concentration dependence for top-end effects.
The strongest outcomes, especially with the Life Equation, still require the right window and full control.

crucialFeats: Experiences all time lines at once.
Manipulates the history of the Metaverse to reshape the New 52, then reverses his own changes in a single act of will (Doomsday Clock).

dossier.advantage: Sees all timelines at once and the future of the fight before it begins.
dossier.mentality: A detached observer with a cold, fatalistic outlook. Manhattan does not react like an ordinary human, because he sees events as part of an already existing chain of cause and effect.
dossier.quote: Yes. I see now. Everything ends.
dossier.style: Total control over matter and atoms. He does not fight in a traditional way — he disintegrates targets, rearranges their structure, or removes them from the flow of the fight through a single act of will.

fighterB.name: Dr. Manhattan

powers: Atomic manipulation, matter disintegration/reconstruction, self-reassembly, and simultaneous time perception.
tools: Space-time intervention and causal interference instead of a regular fight.
weaknesses: Tachyon particles can disrupt his perception of time, reducing him to a limited 'here and now' view.
Emotional detachment and fatalism can delay the moment when he chooses to act decisively.

battle-dynamics.label: Life Equation + Source Route: Open
battle-dynamics.phase_1: With full Life Equation, Kyle becomes a stable point in the continuum that Manhattan cannot instantly disperse.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: The clash rises to the level of rewrite versus preemption. Kyle tries to stabilize the Life Equation and open the Source Route before Manhattan breaks the activation sequence itself.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: If Kyle completes the Life Equation and the Source Route, the fight stops being a normal power exchange and begins to tilt his way.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Full Life Equation is the only version of this fight that becomes an even duel of wills.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Without full Life Equation activation, Kyle remains a massively powerful White Lantern, but he does not yet reach the level of reality control needed to truly take the fight away from Manhattan.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Kyle tries to fight through constructs, but Manhattan erases the matter they are built from before they can land.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Manhattan closes the fight before Kyle can stabilize the Life Equation or enter the Source Route.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: With limited Life Equation, Manhattan controls the clash with mathematical certainty.

fight-simulation.label: Life Equation + Source Route: Open
fight-simulation.opening: Kyle opens the fight with White Light, trying to build a stable entry into the Life Equation and the Source Route.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Manhattan tries to break the entire process at the level of atoms, time, and causality before Kyle can complete the full activation sequence.
fight-simulation.late_fight: If Kyle holds control long enough, the fight begins to shift from a power exchange into an attempt at rewrite or Source-linked imprisonment of Manhattan.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Kyle wins by fully completing the Life Equation and the Source Route.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Kyle tries to build a stable entry into the Life Equation and the Source Route before Manhattan can break the activation sequence itself.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Manhattan tries to break the entire process at the level of atoms, time, and causality before Kyle can complete the full activation sequence.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Kyle sustains the process long enough for the fight not to end immediately.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Manhattan keeps searching for the moment where he can break the entire activation chain.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: If Kyle holds control long enough, the fight begins to shift from a power exchange into an attempt at rewrite or Source-linked imprisonment of Manhattan.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: This is the only branch where Kyle truly starts turning the fight his way.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Without fully closing this route, the advantage returns to Manhattan's preemption.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Manhattan appears at several moments in time simultaneously, disorienting Kyle.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Manhattan breaks Kyle's activation process before the Life Equation and the Source Route can reach a fully active state.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Kyle cannot stabilize the highest level of his own power.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Each new attempt is interrupted before it can turn into a real rewrite.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Manhattan closes the fight before Kyle can stabilize the Life Equation and enter the Source Route.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Kyle is broken apart before his highest state can affect the course of the clash.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Manhattan's preemption cuts off the entire path to rewrite and imprisonment.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Manhattan's victory by removing the opponent from history.

final-summary.line_1: Kyle Rayner has the higher ceiling because the Life Equation and the Source Route give him a path to affecting the foundations of reality.
final-summary.line_2: Dr. Manhattan does not have to wait for the fight to develop — he can cut Kyle off from the Life Equation and the Source Route through preemption, direct interference, or immediate disintegration.
final-summary.line_3: This is a fight between Kyle's greater ceiling and Manhattan's earlier, more reliable first move.
final-summary.winner: Kyle has the greater end potential. Manhattan still wins more often because he more often cuts off the path to that potential before it becomes a real threat.

tactical-board.lane: Kyle must force an action window before Manhattan erases the very cause of his existence.
tactical-board.subtitle: Willpower versus Causality

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Conditional result: entry into Life Equation + Source Route vs Manhattan preemption
verdict-matrix.case_1: Kyle Rayner 4/10. If Kyle activates the full Life Equation quickly and maintains stable control over it, he can reach a level where his advantage starts to genuinely outscale Manhattan's preemption.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Dr. Manhattan 6/10. If Kyle fails to secure full and stable activation in time, Manhattan more often takes the initiative and closes the fight through preemption.

x-factor.factor: LIFE EQUATION + SOURCE ROUTE VS MANHATTAN'S PREEMPTION
x-factor.mechanika: Kyle has the Life Equation, but his most dangerous win path runs through the Source Route: rewriting or imprisoning the opponent through logic tied to the Source itself.
x-factor.implikacja: Manhattan's preemption is always on: he sees timelines at once and can act before Kyle stabilizes the Life Equation or opens the Source Route.
x-factor.psychologia: If Kyle fails to enter the Life Equation and Source Route in time, his higher ceiling never gets to shape the fight.
